response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, deep technical versatility across languages and systems, and demonstrable leadership in open-source and team mentoring — aligning well with the role’s consulting and engineering excellence expectations. However, his resume lacks explicit evidence of 8+ years focused on production-grade AI/GenAI systems, vector databases, RAG architectures, or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph, which are core to the role.
strengths: Proven leadership in technical infrastructure and agentic workflow tooling at re:cinq
Extensive experience building scalable cloud-native systems on AWS and Kubernetes
Strong track record of mentoring, workshops, and driving engineering best practices
concerns: No clear evidence of 8+ years dedicated to AI/GenAI production systems
Missing explicit experience with vector databases or RAG architecture implementation
Limited mention of LLM metrics, optimization, or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph
